keyEvents.text: Goal! San Marino 0, Belarus 1. Kirill Gomanov (Belarus) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Valeri Gromyko with a cross following a corner.
Goal! San Marino 0, Belarus 2. Artem Kontsevoy (Belarus) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Timofey Simanenka.
Delay in match because of an injury Max Ebong (Belarus).
Delay in match because of an injury Marco Pasolini (San Marino).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Gabriel Capicchioni (San Marino) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Belarus. Trofim Melnichenko replaces Timofey Simanenka.
Second Half begins San Marino 0, Belarus 2.
Substitution, San Marino. Samuel Pancotti replaces Enea Della Balda.
Substitution, San Marino. Andrea Contadini replaces Gabriel Capicchioni.
Substitution, Belarus. Aleksandr Svirepa replaces Aleksandr Selyava.
Substitution, Belarus. Anton Kovalev replaces Valeri Gromyko.
Substitution, San Marino. Alessandro Golinucci replaces Lorenzo Capicchioni.
Samuele Zannoni (San Marino) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Vladislav Kalinin (Belarus).
Substitution, San Marino. Fausto Salicioni replaces Lorenzo Lazzari.
Substitution, San Marino. Alessandro Tosi replaces Filippo Fabbri.
Substitution, Belarus. Anton Lukashov replaces Vladislav Kalinin because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Aleksandr Svirepa (Belarus) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
